title: Testing Persona
description: A persona whose purpose is finding defects a real user base would hit. Grounded in MODEL.md: testing-behavior dimensions (PersonaTester) + temperament (Big Five) + context + real-traffic weighting (data-driven personas) + intent/memory agent (UXAgent/Generative Agents).

class.description: mainstream = traffic-weighted real user; edge = valid-but-rare; adversarial = deliberate misuse/attack (fixed weight, not traffic-weighted).

intent.description: The goal the persona pursues (UXAgent). Drives the decision loop; not a fixed script.

goal.description: e.g. 'Sign up and reach the dashboard', 'Buy one item and check out'.

success_signal.description: Observable condition that means the goal was met, e.g. 'URL contains /dashboard'.

testing_behavior.description: The three PersonaTester dimensions — what actually changes defect-finding behavior.

mindset.description: coherent = sequential, follows flows; nonlinear = divergent, jumps around.

exploration.description: Where attention goes: UI surface, the primary feature, or form fields.

input_habit.description: What they type: short valid, long valid (boundary), or invalid (negative testing).

temperament.description: Big Five → behavioral knobs (MODEL.md §1.6). ocean is optional provenance; the knobs are what the runner consumes.

ocean.description: Optional OCEAN scores 0..1 this temperament was derived from.

speed.description: Action pace; maps to think-time and typing delay.

grounding.description: Data-driven provenance (MODEL.md Layer A). Present when derived from real analytics/session logs rather than hand-written.

population_weight.description: Share of real traffic this persona represents. Feeds reach in priority = severity × reach. Adversarial personas use a small fixed weight.

derived_from_cluster.description: ID of the session cluster this was derived from.

usage_model.description: Path/ref to the Markov usage model biasing this persona's navigation.

mode.description: script = fixed steps (regression); intent = LLM pursues the goal via the decision loop; explore = monkey/usage-model-biased exploration.

steps.description: Only for mode=script. Action list (see persona_runner.js ACTIONS).
